context.description: The directory is free once the run machine is final, even while the summary waits

evidence.trustReason: Given: SessionPrompt runs a real root bash turn held by Permission.list/reply. When: the resumed S4 judge stores its verdict, the folded run is done. Then: the scoped replacement keeps TaskHarness.make and forwards its release; at the first real release call it observes the held lease, the run supervisor context's actual writer fiber ended, and the decoded done status on disk before forwarding. A release-before-write would show a running writer or missing/non-done status, so D19's former free-lease polling false positive is closed. Before permission reply the job remains running and no summary exists. A second SessionPrompt.command for /task returns the later git refusal, not the busy reply. After permission reply one parent-linked summary is written; when the root session was removed one closing-summary failure is logged.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI24 The directory is free once the run machine is final, even while the summary waits
    Given a root session whose turn waits on a permission prompt
    When the run actor reaches done
    Then the lease is released after the writer writes the done snapshot and before the summary
    And the next /task in the directory is not busy
    And the summary is written once, when the root turn ends, or its failure is logged when the root session goes away

  @phase4 @compat
